SCP-5392 is a humanoid creature resembling a young female adult approximately 3.06 meters tall with long arms stretching its entire body length and legs 0.96 meters tall. Despite being humanoid SCP-5392 shows no signs of human intelligence or speech, only mumbling unrecognizable language in raspy utterance.

Deleted at -18 and three votes.

SCP-5986 is a species of plant, known to the public as Artica flora. Massive data about SCP-5986 is known to the public due to it having a similar appearance to Bellis perris and it being found by Canadians. SCP-5986 can only grow in areas with a temperature of less than, or equal to, 4°C.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5890 is similar in appearance to a human female though it's skin resembles smooth tree bark, most closely resembling that of Quercus Alba(white oak). It is approximately 1.65 meters tall and appears to be pregnant.

Deleted at -21 and three votes.

/scp-5196 (no title) by Doctor Viking deleted at -21 and three votes.

The supplement page /an-image-of-scp-5196-in-containment by the same user also deleted at -19. Zyn witnessed.

SCP-5196 is an inanimate humanoid object that takes the form of a golden statue with minor scratching to the front. Upon physical contact with SCP-5196, the subject (Now stated as SCP-5196-2) will be melted into a molten gold liquid that will then fuse into SCP-5196, furthermore, if an instance of SCP-5196-2 should be caught SCP-5196-2 should be brought to a high power freezing device that is able to reach -20 degrees Celcius for no less than 72 hours.

Feedback ported:

[+] from kingmeatballs
– hide block

Ok so you seem to be having trouble inserting an image, let me help you.

So first near the discuss tab there will be a file tab click on it, this is where you can upload the image you want to use. Then once you have uploaded the image your going to have to insert this code

[[include component:image-block | name=THE NAME OF YOUR IMAGE FILE | caption=THE TEXT UNDERNEATH THE IMAGE | width=WIDTH-GOES-HERE]]

From the looks of things im assuming your new to the site? If so please read How To Write An SCP it is amazing for new users. Have a good day :)

item.content:encoded:
Deleted an article by Dreswrites at -30 with three staff votes, standard deletion process.

SCP-5897 is a humanoid looking child that doesn’t seem to age and seems to be able to bend reality. Can be harmed by almost nothing and seems to be completely heat resistant. Has the ability to cause a nuclear level of explosion that doesn’t harm them. The skin of the entity temperature 1,300 Fahrenheit but can’t actually melt anything. the entity does need food and water.

No feedback present.

Deleted an article by Musca-Alex at -23 with three staff votes, standard deletion process.

Description: SCP-5129 resembles a standard M11 pistol that uses ordinary 9mm Parabellum bullets. When shot the bullet will create a spacial anomaly that allows any entity to travel from one place to another. The spatial anomalies that SCP-5129 creates are linked together making it possible to jump from one anomaly to the other. SCP-5129 can create a maximum of 2 anomalies at a time, attempting to make more will cause the oldest one to disappear. Reloading the gun will cause all anomalies to disappear. If any anomaly disappears near a living entity it will also disappear in an unknown place.

No feedback present.

Deleted an article by TheKidNamedCover at -21 with three staff votes, standard deletion process.

Description: SCP-5819 is a gold amulet, with a ruby1 in the middle. When wearing SCP-5819, humans and gorillas begin to shrink until they’re so small, they’re invisible to the naked eye. When any other animal wears SCP-5819, they will grow until they either grow so big the ground beneath them can’t handle it’s mass and collapses or they die. SCP-5819 is observed to change size along with the subject until taken off. When SCP-5819 is took off a subject, the effect still remains.

Feedback is as follows:

+ Jabobai
– Jabobai

An amulet that shrinks certain lifeforms and enlarges others would make a fine SCP in my opinion. But the tone is perhaps not as clinical as it could be, and the addenda read as if they're written by an Elizabethan street urchin instead of a Foundation employee. No vote for now, but I look forward to seeing how this SCP evolves.

+ Koke Ghoul
– Koke Ghoul

I honestly have no idea where this article is going. It's a thing that makes your size change, then it got stolen, then… What? Am I just supposed to be left at a cliffhanger? I mean, cliffhangers are more than fine, but they have to leave me with something to anticipate or at least think about. Thing is, there's nothing to think about because there were no stakes or setup. All I'm getting from this is that the Foundation just suddenly gave up on one of their objects, which is extremely irresponsible of them and not a satisfying conclusion or a satisfying cliffhanger (if even a cliffhanger at all). The incident log also feels very random and it has almost no content in it.

Try looking for more feedback in the Ideas Critique Forum and the Drafts Critique Forum.

Footnotes
1. SCP-5819-1 SCP-5819-C

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
scp-5871 (Clay Man and a weird object) by TheKidNamedCover deleted at -19 and three votes.

SCP-5871 is clay, moulded in the shape of a vaguely humanoid entity. SCP-5871 absorbs clay on contact. SCP-5871 lacks a nose, ears and arms. SCP-5871 is sapient and capable of verbal communication, however, SCP-5871 can’t structure sentences properly.

Feedback ported:

[+] from HarryBlank
– hide block

If it's going to be short, it has to do something special, fast. It has to provide some sort of twist, swerve, revelation that makes the reader think "wow, you got there with the minimum words required, that's incredible." It can't just be a short description with crosslinks to other people's stuff.

[+] from ItsDenali
– hide block

A tip moving forward, referencing "popular" Series 1 SCPs/basing your entire SCP around them is not a very good idea and doesn't make an article more appealing. To get a better idea of the current meta, so to speak, try checking out some more recent SCPs in Series 5 and 6. Good luck.

scp-5133 (no title) by LastLife0907 deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5133 appears to be a life size bust of King David from the Hebrew Bible. The object is about 63 cm tall (25 in) and about 40 cm wide (16 in). Close research on the object has determined that it is made of a mixture of 43% porcelain 37% terracotta, and 19% concrete, and 1% uranium. SCP-5133 is sentient, and is capable of speech in languages such as English, French, Hebrew, and Greek.

Feedback ported:

[+] from RogerWiki 
– hide block

Not a big fan of 'dangerous SCP just wandering around because we can't figure out Contain' and I don't think there's any good reason to not make it more-easily containable.

scp-5148 (no title) by Kenyo deleted at -17 and three votes.

The entity is a biped creature approximately three meters in length. The creature has a deformed reindeer skull as its head. Two reindeer’s woods stick out of the side of its head.Mushroom grows out of its skull and some spots are covered in lichen.

Feedback ported:

[+] from HarryBlank
– hide block

Many spelling and grammar errors as well. Check out the How to Write an SCP page to see the process for getting criticism on your work, so you can present something to the mainsite that has a chance of sticking. If you've got an idea you like, it's worth the effort to make it shine.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5668 are small, semi-humanoid carnivorous creatures with an average standing height of 4 ft. SCP-5668 are observed to move at speeds of 20 to 30mph on all fours across any solid surface, showing the ability to run across ceilings and walls. These creatures often have deformed limbs, doubled heads or limbs, and other birth defects that seem to only help them in hunting or feeding. SCP-5668 has an unhinging jaw that can open at a 150-degree angle and close with a bite force of around 4,000 psi(17,790 newtons).

Deletion at -19 and three votes.

SCP-5176 is a tombstone measuring approximately 50 centimeters wide, 25 centimeters tall, and 10 centimeters thick. Material analyses of SCP-5176 show ordinary granite with a composition similar to that found in ███████ ██████, North Carolina.

Deleted at -16 and three votes.

SCP 5127 is an ancient artifact of Mayan origin. The artifact is in the shape of a wolf and constructed of an unknown metal. The artifact appears to have the ability to resurrect people within 2 meters of it into mutants (labeled as SCP 5127-1) in a period of 2-8 minutes. After the deceased creature being resurrected the mutation will begin by their pigment losing its color and becoming grey, the number of muscles and limbs increasing, and their height decreasing. After the completion of the process, the mutant will become significantly more aggressive and predatorial. Mutants as well appear to listen to the commands of SCP 5127-A. SCP 5127-A is a creature carrying and protecting the artifact.

Deleted at -15 and three votes.
